tools.name: A11y Contrast Grid Generator
tools.shortDescription: Generate a comprehensive accessibility matrix comparing all background and foreground color combinations against WCAG 2.1 contrast guidelines.
tools.longDescription:
## A11y Contrast Grid Generator

An interactive utility to evaluate a color palette's accessibility by generating a comprehensive grid comparing all background/foreground color combinations against WCAG 2.1 contrast guidelines.

### Features

- **Interactive Palette Manager**: Add, edit, or delete custom colors (HEX, RGB, HSL) with real-time swatch previews.
- **Accessibility Compliance Matrix**: Generates a matrix comparing every color as background against every color as foreground, displaying contrast ratios and WCAG status (AA, AAA, or Fail) for normal and large text.
- **Intelligent Filtering**: Filter the grid to show only compliant combinations, only AA-compliant, or only AAA-compliant pairs.
- **Design Tokens Export**: Export color combinations as Tailwind configurations, CSS custom properties, SCSS variables, or JSON.
- **Export Capabilities**: Export the final contrast grid as an SVG, CSV, or formatted HTML snippet.

tools.name: Advanced Robots.txt Generator
tools.shortDescription: Visually create and customize robots.txt files with support for multiple user-agents, crawl rules, sitemaps, and instant code generation.
tools.longDescription:
## Advanced Robots.txt Generator

Generate a valid robots.txt file through an intuitive visual interface. Configure multiple user-agent groups, Allow/Disallow directives, Crawl-delay values, optional Host directives, and XML Sitemaps while seeing the generated robots.txt update instantly.

### Features

- Visual editor for robots.txt generation
- Support for multiple User-agent groups
- Add Allow and Disallow rules with one click
- Optional Crawl-delay directive for each user-agent
- Optional Host directive support
- Add multiple XML Sitemap URLs
- Built-in presets including Allow All, Disallow All, Standard SEO, and WordPress Base
- Live syntax-highlighted robots.txt preview
- Copy generated robots.txt to the clipboard
- Download the generated file as robots.txt
- Fully responsive interface with modern dark theme
- Built with HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript with no backend required

tools.name: Animation Cubic-Bezier Editor
tools.shortDescription: Visually create and customize CSS cubic-bezier() easing functions with a live animation preview.
tools.longDescription:
## Animation Cubic-Bezier Editor

A professional visual editor for crafting custom CSS easing functions.

### Features

- **Interactive Canvas:** Draggable control points to visually sculpt your bezier curve.
- **Live Preview:** Real-time animation box to instantly test how your easing feels.
- **Smart Presets:** One-click load standard easings (`ease`, `ease-in`, `ease-out`, `ease-in-out`, `linear`).
- **Instant Export:** Auto-generates standard-compliant `cubic-bezier()` CSS syntax with a 1-click copy feature.
- **Offline First:** Operates entirely client-side using Vanilla JS and native SVG manipulation.

tools.name: Bash Sandbox
tools.shortDescription: A simulated bash terminal to play with and learn common commands, entirely in your browser.
tools.longDescription:
## Bash Sandbox

A simulated bash terminal environment that runs entirely in your browser. It's a safe and fun way to learn and experiment with common shell commands like `ls`, `cd`, `cat`, `mkdir`, and `echo` without any risk to your system. The sandbox operates on a virtual file system that resets on every page load.

### Features

- A realistic terminal-like interface.
- Support for core commands: `ls`, `cd`, `cat`, `mkdir`, `touch`, `pwd`, `echo`, `clear`, and `help`.
- A virtual file system to navigate and manipulate.
- Command history using up/down arrow keys.
- Tab autocompletion for paths.
- Works entirely offline.

tools.name: Commit Message & Range Cleaner
tools.shortDescription: Paste a git log excerpt and generate interactive-rebase plans + normalized Conventional Commits suggestions.
tools.longDescription:
## Commit Message & Range Cleaner

Parse git log outputs and visually design interactive rebases. Automatically audit and normalize commit messages into compliant Conventional Commits standards.

### Features

- Parse standard multiline git log outputs or compact git log --oneline listings
- Order commits sequentially from oldest to newest to match Git rebase workflow expectations
- Automatically translate messy commit subjects into Conventional Commits patterns
- Flag unquoted keywords, casing, periods, and length violations with inline visual warnings
- Customize rebase actions (pick, reword, squash, fixup, drop, edit) on an interactive planner dashboard
- Copy generated git-rebase-todo contents directly to terminal rebase sessions
- Export summaries of reworded changelogs and download configurations as JSON files

tools.name: Commit Message Generator
tools.shortDescription: Build Conventional Commits-formatted commit messages with live preview and validation.
tools.longDescription:
## Commit Message Generator

A visual Conventional Commits builder with live preview, syntax highlighting, and instant copy buttons.

### Features

- Support for standard types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, and revert
- Optional scope, breaking change flag, description, body, and issue footer
- Real-time formatted commit message preview
- One-click copy for the commit message and full git commit command
- Runs completely offline in your browser

tools.name: CSS Animation Builder
tools.shortDescription: Visually create CSS animations and export keyframes without manually writing CSS.
tools.longDescription:
## CSS Animation Builder

Visually construct custom CSS animations with presets, interactive property controls, live preview canvas, and instant CSS keyframe export.

### Features

- Visual controls for animation name, duration, timing function, iterations, and direction
- Animation presets including bounce, pulse, spin, fade in, slide up, and shake
- Interactive live preview target with replay button and grid backdrop
- Real-time syntax-highlighted CSS code generator
- One-click copy to clipboard

tools.name: CSS Easing Visualizer
tools.shortDescription: Compare multiple CSS easing curves side-by-side on a shared graph and in an animated race preview.
tools.longDescription:
## CSS Easing Visualizer

Compare multiple CSS easing curves side-by-side — see their shape on a shared graph and watch them race in an animated preview, so you can pick the right motion feel by comparison rather than editing one curve in isolation.

### Features

- Add and remove multiple curves (named presets or custom cubic-bezier values)
- Shared, color-coded SVG graph plotting each curve's progress over time
- Animated race track with one ball per curve, driven by the Web Animations API
- Adjustable shared duration for a fair comparison
- Legend showing each curve's resolved CSS easing value
- Runs completely offline

tools.name: CSS Unit Converter
tools.shortDescription: Instantly convert between px, rem, em, vw, vh, and percentages.
tools.longDescription:
## CSS Unit Converter

A professional utility for frontend developers to instantly convert between absolute and relative CSS units.

### Features

- **Comprehensive Conversions:** Supports `px`, `rem`, `em`, `vw`, `vh`, `%`, and `pt`.
- **Dynamic Base Context:** Set custom base font sizes and viewport dimensions for highly accurate relative calculations.
- **Real-Time Engine:** Values update instantly across all unit fields as you type.
- **One-Click Copy:** Copy individual values instantly to your clipboard.
- **Offline First:** Zero dependencies, running entirely within the browser memory.

tools.name: Curl Builder
tools.shortDescription: Construct ready-to-run cURL commands for REST APIs with headers, auth, body types, query params, and file uploads.
tools.longDescription:
## Curl Builder

Build and copy shell-ready cURL commands with support for query parameters, headers, auth modes, JSON/form/raw bodies, and multipart file upload.

### Features

- Select HTTP method and request URL
- Add query parameters and custom headers
- Basic auth and bearer token support
- JSON / form / raw body payload support
- Multipart file upload field support
- Copy command to clipboard instantly
- Offline-first single HTML file with no dependencies

tools.name: Favicon Generator
tools.shortDescription: Generate a complete favicon pack and integration tags from any image, offline.
tools.longDescription:
## Favicon Generator

A client-side tool that turns any image into a full favicon pack — no server, no upload.

### Features

- Generates 7 sizes (16, 32, 48, 64, 180, 192, 512px)
- Center-crop auto-resize via Canvas
- Live preview grid with individual downloads
- Ready-to-paste HTML `<link>` tags
- One-click ZIP export of the full pack
- Works completely offline

tools.name: Git Ignore Generator
tools.shortDescription: Generate boilerplate .gitignore files for various technologies instantly, offline.
tools.longDescription:
## Git Ignore Generator

Generate boilerplate .gitignore files tailored to your development stack with searchable tags and instant export.

### Features

- Over 20 curated technology templates including Node, Python, Rust, Go, Java, React, Vue, OS, and IDEs
- Instant search and multi-select tags
- Live syntax-formatted .gitignore output preview
- One-click copy to clipboard and .gitignore file download

tools.name: GitHub Profile README Generator
tools.shortDescription: Generate a professional GitHub profile README with live stats and an editable preview.
tools.longDescription:
## GitHub Profile README Generator

This tool helps developers create a professional and visually appealing README for their GitHub profile. It provides a simple form to input personal details and automatically generates the corresponding Markdown, complete with social links, skill badges, and live-fetched GitHub statistics.

### Features

- Live Markdown editor with a rendered preview tab.
- Fetches and displays GitHub stats (total stars, forks, contributions) automatically.
- Generates sections for a bio, tech stack (with badges), and social media links (with icons).
- Allows for direct editing of the generated Markdown.
- Provides "Copy Markdown" and "Download README.md" functionality.
- Runs entirely in the browser, ensuring user privacy.

tools.name: JSON CSV Converter
tools.shortDescription: Convert between JSON and CSV formats with bidirectional conversion.
tools.longDescription:
## JSON CSV Converter

Convert structured data between JSON and CSV formats in both directions with customizable delimiters and syntax validation.

### Features

- Bidirectional conversion: JSON to CSV and CSV to JSON
- Customizable delimiters including Comma, Tab, Semicolon, and Pipe
- Real-time row and item count statistics
- Inline syntax error reporting and validation
- Sample data presets for instant testing

tools.name: Markdown Previewer
tools.shortDescription: Write and preview Markdown in real time, offline.
tools.longDescription:
## Markdown Previewer

A full-featured Markdown editor with real-time rendered preview, syntax highlighting, customizable layout modes, and dark theme support.

### Features

- Real-time GitHub Flavored Markdown rendering
- Code block syntax highlighting via highlight.js
- Draggable split-pane resizer with Split, Editor-only, and Preview-only view modes
- Word count, character count, and persistent local storage auto-save
- One-click Copy Markdown and Copy HTML buttons
- Dark and light theme toggle

tools.name: Sitemap Generator
tools.shortDescription: A standalone Sitemap Generator that helps users create valid XML sitemaps for websites entirely offline.
tools.longDescription:
## Sitemap Generator

A standalone Sitemap Generator that helps users create valid XML sitemaps for websites.

### Features

- Add multiple website URLs individually.
- **New:** Bulk Import a list of URLs instantly via copy-paste.
- Set last modified (lastmod) date.
- Configure change frequency (changefreq) and priority values.
- Generate valid XML sitemap with real-time XML preview.
- One-click copy generated XML or download as sitemap.xml.
- Works completely offline with no dependencies.

tools.name: YAML / JSON Converter
tools.shortDescription: Convert between YAML and JSON in either direction, with validation and pretty-printed output.
tools.longDescription:
## YAML / JSON Converter

Convert between YAML and JSON in either direction with live validation and customizable indentation.

### Features

- Bidirectional conversion between YAML and JSON with instant swap
- Configurable indentation options: 2 spaces, 4 spaces, or tabs
- Live parse error reporting and sample presets
- One-click copy output and load output as input
- Client-side parsing using js-yaml with zero server roundtrips
